content.value: Primary reading: Rozanski and Woods, Chapters 8-10. Supplemental: SEI architecture evaluation material. This unit focuses on identifying stakeholders.

Stakeholders include far more than end users and sponsors. Operators, testers, security teams, support staff, auditors, data owners, maintainers, developers, adjacent system teams, and future project teams may all rely on architectural choices.
Stakeholder analysis is not a formality. It is the mechanism that reveals concerns early enough to shape architecture rather than appear later as costly rework.
Studio: build a stakeholder map for an online banking feature and write one architectural concern for each stakeholder group.

concepts.name: Stakeholder
concepts.description: A person, group, or organization with an interest in or influence over the architecture or system outcome.

concepts.name: Stakeholder map
concepts.description: A structured list or diagram of stakeholders and their relationship to the system.

concepts.name: Concern elicitation
concepts.description: The activity of discovering stakeholder needs, risks, questions, and constraints.

concepts.name: Architecture audience
concepts.description: The group of people for whom a particular architecture description, view, or decision record is written.
